description: Free standard shipping threshold uses > instead of >= (an order of exactly $50.00 pays shipping)
Percent promo discount is rounded down (Math.floor) instead of to the nearest cent
Adding to cart no longer checks the stock (only the per-line limit of 10)
Low-stock threshold is exclusive: a stock of exactly 5 shows "In stock"
Order status transition shipped → cancelled is allowed
Search ranking rewritten as a for loop without the increment: hangs for names whose first word does not match
Cart view: line total shows the unit price (copy-paste from the price column)
Order detail view: total shows the subtotal (discount and shipping ignored)
A promo code is already expired at the exact moment of its expiry time (>= instead of >)
A promo code is rejected when the subtotal equals the minimum order exactly (<= instead of <)
Free-shipping threshold is checked against the subtotal instead of the amount after the discount
Stock check ignores the items already in the cart (compares only the requested quantity)
Price filter excludes products priced exactly at the maximum (>= instead of >)
Page count is rounded down, so the last partial page is unreachable
Results with equal rank are no longer sorted alphabetically
Orders created at the same time are listed oldest id first instead of newest first
Open redirect: protocol-relative targets (//host) are accepted after login
Admin product form accepts a price of zero (< instead of <=)
Catalog counter shows the number of products on the current page instead of the total
Order history shows the raw status code instead of its label
